title: HQ reversion: h1 of runner (post-hoc management check on the failed-ORB pick)
question: Owner 2026-10-23: a strategy that trades 2+ times a week with high-quality, high-probability, high-profit setups - mean reversion at exhaustion (stretched range / both sides swept / stretched into a HTF pool / failed ORB).
verdict: $500 risk, costs in. H1: 33 trades (1.29/wk), true win 45.5%, PF 1.64, net +3,873 ($635/mo), DD -1,469. H2: 20 trades (1.28/wk), true win 40.0%, PF 1.92, net +3,187 ($858/mo), DD -1,240. 2025: 91 trades (1.76/wk), true win 36.3%, PF 0.87, net -3,085 ($-251/mo), DD -6,203. 2021-24: 258 trades (1.58/wk), true win 37.2%, PF 1.03, net +1,658 ($43/mo), DD -11,163. Evals (pass/fail-or-dead %): H1 25K alone 2-wk 5.9/0.0, next to LIT on the 50K 54.6/3.4; H2 25K alone 2-wk 4.3/0.0, next to LIT on the 50K 56.5/0.0; 2025 25K alone 2-wk 3.2/5.6, next to LIT on the 50K 14.9/5.6; 2021-24 25K alone 2-wk 0.4/2.0, next to LIT on the 50K 14.4/10.6.
notes: tools/hq_revert.py; post-hoc management check on the failed-ORB pick (half at 1R, half to the range's other side, BE at 1R)
method: exact live-loop replay (20-day window per session) + cold-streak filter + sizing; costs included
